entities.summary: Syngman Rhee, a notable figure in the history of South Korea, associated with Division, Korean War, and First Republic (1945–1950). Preceded by Jeju Uprising. Their legacy influenced Republic of Korea proclaimed with Syngman Rhee as first president and Jeju Uprising and massacre — up to 30,000 killed in anti-communist campaign.
